names.marshall_field_house_1905_prairie: 1905 Prairie Avenue — the Marshall Field house (Second Empire)

source.citation: [Residence for Marshall and Nannie S. Field, 1905 South Prairie Avenue, Chicago, Illinois]. [First floor plan]. Office of Richard Morris Hunt, architect, [between 1871 and 1873]. Ink and watercolour wash; sheet headed 'Office Copy', 'No 2', 'M. FIELD', 'House for Marshall Field - Chicago Ill.', 'Plan of Principal Floor', 'Scale 1/4" = 1 ft'.
what_it_does_not_supply: the house as built or in 1904: it is a design drawing of 1871-1873
the upper floors, the roof and the elevations
what_it_supplies: the street front's length over all, 55 ft 0 in, and its openings' places
the south flank's length to the rear stair block, 75 ft 9 in
the south-west corner cut on the library octagon's diagonal, about 6 ft 3 in back each way
the conservatory as a segmental bay off the south flank, between the library and the dining room
